46: Here are one hundred dinars for you, and you become betrothed to so-and-so - and he [acts as] his agent, except that he is betrothing her using his own [money].
She is betrothed - even though the money does not belong to the principal.

From the halakha of a Canaanite slave - as is stated in a mishna later on [Kiddushin 22b:6]: "And he can acquire himself by means of money given by others" -- that others can redeem him with their own money, and he acquires himself and goes out to freedom, even though [the slave] loses nothing at all of his own money.
